title: arctotis rueppellii
intro: Arctotis rueppellii, commonly known as the African daisy, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family that is native to the tropical regions of East Africa. The health benefits of Arctotis rueppellii include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Arctotis rueppellii include flavonoids, triterpenes, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
